page_title: BOL 2-1 GEN | Bologna v Genoa 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+11' Valentin Carboni (Genoa) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+9' 2 - 1 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Nicola Leali into right side of the goal.
90+9' It’s a PENALTY to Bologna after the VAR review!

90+4' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bologna players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Giuseppe Collu interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+3' Valentin Carboni (Genoa) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
90+3' The referee awards a corner and Juan Miranda (Bologna) goes over to take it.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' The possession of the ball – 58:42.
85' It's time for a substitution. Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) comes on in place of Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem.
84' Santiago Castro (Bologna) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
78' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
76' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
75' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
73' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Cambiaghi provides Santiago Castro (Bologna) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Bernardeschi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
72' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nikola Moro will be replaced by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna).
70' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
69' Here is a change. Vitinha is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ruslan Malinovskyi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Valentin Carboni (Genoa).
67' Bologna fail to score from a corner as Nicola Leali (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.

67' Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag. Santiago Castro (Bologna) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. His dangerous effort is blocked by Nicola Leali, who makes a glorious save!
66' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
63' 0 - 1 Goal! Ruslan Malinovskyi plays a pass to the feet of Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 0:1.
62' Great ball in from Mikael Egill Ellertsson. Vitinha (Genoa) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
62' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
59' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Lorenzo De Silvestri is replaced by Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
59' Here comes a substitution. Benjamin Dominguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
58' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
58' 2:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
56' Bologna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' That will be all from Lorenzo Colombo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
52' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
48' Juan Miranda (Bologna) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Patrick Vieira gives a chance to Alessandro Marcandalli and Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is off.
46' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle as Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
43' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) gets a yellow card.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Patrizio Masini (Genoa) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Chance! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
38' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
37' Vitinha (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giuseppe Collu had an easy-decision to make.
35' A corner kick by Genoa is thwarted by the well prepared Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna).
35' Aaron Martin (Genoa) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it! Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) makes a strong challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
25' A pass from Vitinha (Genoa) is intercepted by Lukasz Skorupski and the move breaks down.
24' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the bottom left corner that is easily dealt with by Nicola Leali.
21' Nikola Moro (Bologna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
19' Looks like Nikola Moro (Bologna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
18' Vitinha (Genoa) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
18' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
13' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
10' Aaron Martin (Genoa) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
9' Dangerous play by Remo Freuler (Bologna). Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Giuseppe Collu and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
7' Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nikola Moro (Bologna).
5' Close! Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
2' Bologna have a goal ruled out for offside!
2' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

2' Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity. Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
